parameters.prompt:
Extract the following entities from the user message: Marca (Brand), Modelo (Model), Año (Year), Categoría (Category e.g., roof rack, bike rack). Return as JSON.

User Message: {{$json.body.message}}

nodes.name: LLM Entity Extraction
nodes.notes: Creates anchor entities for fitment, commerce, and documentary branches.

parameters.query: SELECT v.brand, v.model, v.year_start, v.year_end, v.roof_type, fk.foot_pack_sku, fk.bar_front_sku, fk.bar_rear_sku, fk.kit_sku, fk.max_load_kg, vpf.product_sku, vpf.is_compatible, vpf.fitment_notes FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN fitment_kits fk ON v.id = fk.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_product_fitment vpf ON v.id = vpf.vehicle_id WHERE v.brand ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' AND v.model % $2 AND v.year_start <= $3::int AND (v.year_end >= $3::int OR v.year_end IS NULL OR v.year_end = 9999) LIMIT 10;

nodes.name: PostgreSQL Search
nodes.notes: Fitment authority branch. Existing compatibility logic is preserved.

parameters.query: WITH latest_snapshot AS ( SELECT snapshot_id, snapshot_at FROM tecbite_catalog_snapshot WHERE status IN ('success','partial') ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ps.product_sku, ps.title, ps.price_amount, ps.currency, ps.stock_status, ps.promo_text, ps.source_url, ps.fresh_until, ls.snapshot_at FROM latest_snapshot ls JOIN tecbite_product_state ps ON ps.snapshot_id = ls.snapshot_id WHERE ($1 = '' OR ps.category ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR ps.title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') ORDER BY ps.ingested_at DESC LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Tecbite Latest Commerce Query
nodes.notes: MVP practical branch querying latest Tecbite snapshot/state for transactional fields.

parameters.query: SELECT c.chunk_id, LEFT(c.chunk_text, 600) AS chunk_text, d.source_url, d.locale, COALESCE(c.metadata->>'source', '') AS source FROM thule_document_chunk c JOIN thule_document d ON d.doc_id = c.doc_id WHERE d.is_active = TRUE AND d.locale = 'es-PA' AND LOWER(COALESCE(c.metadata->>'source', '')) = 'thule.com' AND ( ($1 <> '' AND c.chunk_text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') OR ($2 <> '' AND c.chunk_text ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') OR ($3 <> '' AND c.chunk_text ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%') OR ($1 = '' AND $2 = '' AND $3 = '') ) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;

nodes.name: Thule Context Query
nodes.notes: MVP fallback retrieval via ILIKE. TODO: switch to PGVector similarity query when node config supports vector parameterization.

nodes.name: Deterministic Merge Strategy (MVP)
nodes.notes: Deterministic precedence is enforced: fitment > tecbite > thule. Emits provenance + observability markers.
